headline: Recommended GreenTech Park TIF zone, Lakeside and Garland Avenue housing TIF deal, and zoning changes at 455 Grove Street and Hermon Street.
summary: Recommended approval of a GreenTech Park TIF zone and a UCH-TIF agreement for Lakeside and Garland Avenue properties. Also recommended zoning map changes for 455 Grove Street, the Belmont and Plantation Street corridor, and an area around Hermon Street. Chairman's orders asked for a glossary of terms and a traffic review near 42 Hermon Street.
decisions: Approved the minutes of the June 25, 2026 meeting, 3 yeas and 0 nays.
Recommended approval of a resolution establishing a Tax Increment Financing Zone for GreenTech Park, 3 yeas and 0 nays.
Recommended approval of a resolution to approve an Urban Center Housing TIF agreement for 16 - 32 Lakeside Avenue and 18 - 20 Garland Avenue, 3 yeas and 0 nays.
Recommended approval of a zoning map change for 455 Grove St. from split RL-7 and BG-3.0 to entirely BG-3.0, 3 yeas and 0 nays.
Recommended approval of a zoning map amendment for the Belmont Street / Plantation Street Corridor, 3 yeas and 0 nays.
Recommended approval of a zone change extending the BG-3 and CCOD-E districts to 9, 15 and 25 Charlton St., 26, 38, 42 and 46 Hermon St., and 0 Beacon St., 3 yeas and 0 nays.

# 11.4B CM August 18, 2026

Chairperson Councilor Bergman read the item and recognized the Chief Development Officer , 
who provided an overview of the item.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman recognized Councilor Toomey, who discussed the Responsible 
Development Ordinance contract and the percentage of local employees for the project with the 
Chief Development Officer.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman recognized Councilor Mitra, who discussed the timeframe, the 
total investment amount and amount of taxes the city will receive for the project with the Chief 
Development Officer.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman then discussed the estimated taxes the city will receive after the 
18-year period with the Chief Development Officer.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman brought forth the following Chairman’s Order: Request City 
Manager request Chief Development Officer provide City Council with a glossary of frequently 
used terms related to Executive Office of Economic Development programs.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman recognized Councilor Mitra, who discussed the estimated savings 
to the project over the 20-year term of the agreement with the Chief Development Officer.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman then discussed what happens if the project gets sold during the 
TIF period to another entity with the Chief Development Officer.
Chairperson Councilor Bergman moved for a roll call vote to recommend item be approved.
Recommend Approval on a roll call vote of 3 Yeas and 0 Nays
